Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement danger zone functionality (password change, deactivate, delete)

API Endpoints Created:
- /api/user/password (PUT) - Change password
  - Validates current password before allowing change
  - Hashes new password securely
  - Revokes all other sessions for security
  - Zod validation for password requirements

- /api/user/deactivate (POST) - Deactivate account
  - Sets user.isActive to false
  - Revokes all sessions
  - Reversible by contacting support

- /api/user/delete (DELETE) - Permanently delete account
  - Requires typing "DELETE" to confirm
  - Permanently removes user and all related data (cascading)
  - Cannot be reversed

Settings Page Updates:
- Password Change:
  - Real API integration with validation
  - Toast notifications for success/error
  - Clears form on success
  - Shows specific error messages (incorrect password, etc.)

- Account Deactivation:
  - Confirmation dialog before proceeding
  - API integration
  - Auto-logout and redirect to login page
  - Toast notification with message

- Account Deletion:
  - Prompt for "DELETE" confirmation
  - API integration with validation
  - Auto-logout and redirect to home page
  - Permanent action warning

Security Features:
- Password verification before changes
- Session revocation on password change
- All endpoints protected with withAuth middleware
- Proper error handling and user feedback

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Replace native browser dialogs with custom modals (DRY)

Created Reusable Modal Components:
- ConfirmModal: Simple yes/no confirmation with customizable variants
  - Used for account deactivation
  - Props: title, description, confirmText, cancelText, variant
  
- PromptModal: Text input validation modal
  - Used for account deletion with "DELETE" confirmation
  - Props: expectedValue for validation, error handling
  - Shows inline error if validation fails

Settings Page Updates:
- Replaced window.confirm() with ConfirmModal for deactivate
- Replaced window.prompt() with PromptModal for delete
- Added modal state management (showDeactivateModal, showDeleteModal)
- Improved UX with styled modal dialogs instead of native alerts
- Consistent styling with Card components
- Full keyboard support (auto-focus on input)

Benefits:
- DRY: Reusable modal components across the app
- Better UX: Custom styling, animations, consistent look
- Accessibility: Proper focus management and keyboard support
- Maintainability: Single source of truth for modal behavior
